rule: Level-gated optional intro: the login flag is set when level is at or below MaxLevelForTutorial, entry re-checks the level and moves the character to the tutorial zone. Start location comes from a per-(zone or choice, class, deity, race) row with a hard-coded fallback. Starting kit is a table with 0-means-any filter lists on class, race, deity and zone, auto-placed into a free slot when the slot is below the charm slots. Death experience loss starts at a level rule; death item loss starts at a second level rule. Level gain sends a message and a script event; the XP display is a 0/1/2 rule.

data_fields.name: start_location_row
data_fields.unit: (race, class, deity, zone) -> x, y, z, heading, bind

data_fields.name: starting_kit_row
data_fields.unit: filters (class, race, deity, zone; 0 = any), item, charges, slot

change: no hard-coded fallback coordinates in code; one start resolver for every client (donor has two paths: Titanium and SoF)

level-up celebration is client presentation; server sends the event only
